intent: Technical Brief: Dell Alienware Y70 Case Issue
detected_fault: Case screen not working, computer freezing or turning off after 5 minutes without displaying any error messages.
suggested_solution: Check if the graphics card is properly plugged into the motherboard.
Try removing the graphics card and running a benchmark directly from the motherboard to isolate the issue.
Investigate potential driver issues, such as outdated or corrupted drivers for the GPU or other components.
Consider replacing the CMOS battery to clear any BIOS-related issues.
